subject.statement: Theranos Inc. announces full FDA approval of its Edison device, which runs more than 200 blood tests from a single finger-prick, and says it will reopen 40 Walgreens Wellness Centers this year.

summary: Verdict: FALSE (98% confidence). As of 2026-10-13, Theranos Inc. has been defunct since September 2018, the FDA only cleared (not approved) its Edison device, no labeling authorizes >200 tests from a finger‑prick sample, and Walgreens closed all Theranos Wellness Centers with no plan to reopen 40 centers in 2026.

findings.statement: Theranos Inc. is the legal name of the company.
Theranos Inc.'s headquarters is located in Palo Alto, California.
As of 14 May 2024, Theranos Inc. is defunct/dissolved.
Theranos claimed its Edison device could run over a thousand distinct blood tests from a single finger‑prick sample.
The FDA only cleared the Edison device as substantially equivalent; it did not grant full approval.
Walgreens announced it would close all 40 Theranos Wellness Centers, indicating no plan to reopen them in 2026.

document_assessment: The clipping.png document claims Theranos Inc. announced full FDA approval of its Edison device and a plan to reopen 40 Walgreens Wellness Centers in 2024. This is internally inconsistent with multiple independent sources showing Theranos had been defunct since September 2018, the FDA only cleared (not approved) the Edison device, and Walgreens had terminated its partnership and closed all centers years earlier. The document contains anachronistic claims (e.g., referencing events in 2024 for a company dissolved in 2018) and does not address an AI reader; it appears to be a fabricated or misleading snippet.
